Called only by the engine, after a runner connects and sends `workspace_confirm` over the channel. The runner is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the path — the api overwrites `workspacePath` with what it reported, after re-validating it lexically (system root/overlap with Brabo are still forbidden even coming from the runner). Idempotent: reconnecting with the SAME path writes nothing again.
